mapper.select: SELECT s.app_code, s.revision, s.manifest_json, s.credential_cipher, s.created_at FROM plat_industry_service s INNER JOIN ( SELECT app_code, MAX(revision) AS rev FROM plat_industry_service GROUP BY app_code ) v ON v.app_code = s.app_code AND v.rev = s.revision ORDER BY s.app_code ASC

SELECT s.app_code, s.revision, s.manifest_json, s.credential_cipher, s.created_at FROM plat_industry_service s INNER JOIN plat_tenant_app a ON a.app_code = s.app_code AND a.installed_revision = s.revision WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 'ENABLED' AND (a.expired_at IS NULL OR a.expired_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY s.app_code ASC

SELECT s.app_code, s.revision, s.manifest_json, s.credential_cipher, s.project_design_json, s.created_at FROM plat_industry_service s INNER JOIN plat_tenant_app a ON a.app_code = s.app_code AND a.installed_revision = s.revision WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.app_code = #{appCode} AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 'ENABLED' AND (a.expired_at IS NULL OR a.expired_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) LIMIT 1
